props.name: row
props.comment: Lay the radios out horizontally instead of stacked.

props.name: source
props.comment: The FK/field path. Optional under a reference wrapper (inherited from context).

props.name: choices
props.comment: Inline choices (`{ id, name }[]` or `string[]`). Omitted under a reference wrapper.

props.name: optionText
props.comment: The display path (dotted) or a formatter over the whole choice. Default `name`.

props.name: translateChoice
props.comment: Translate a string-path label through the catalog. Default `!isFromReference`.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default value (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
